name: Toudou Miyuki
source:
Gently bright national language teacher. 
She is a gentle beauty that tends to be shy, but she has good proportion, and her breast size is indicative of her mature appearance. She is popular among the boys in her class.
She is in a secret relationship with Eiji, and is worried about his bad relationship with his brother, so she tries to help him any way she can.
